caption: The drawing depicts a wooden piece of furniture resembling a desk with an upper cabinet section. The desk is shown with a dark green or black writing surface and is supported by four fluted legs featuring carved decorative motifs near the top. There are three drawers visible on the front face of the desk, each with round knobs, and paneling detail throughout. The upper portion of the furniture is raised by four small cylindrical legs and consists of a cabinet with four doors, each featuring a simple rectangular panel and individual round or oval handles. The wood throughout the piece has a reddish-brown hue with visible grain patterning, suggesting a highly polished finish. There is a slender metal rod, possibly for support or as a simple rail, running horizontally between the upper cabinet and the desk surface. The background is a plain, light beige, and the artist's signature, "Frank Kuhrmeyer," is visible in the bottom right corner.
title: Desk
